title: Pilot header
description: A pinned two-tier header: a candy-pink announcement strip with an underlined uppercase mono link, over an 80px aubergine bar with a lowercase wordmark, chevroned nav links, a mono sign-in link, a butter-yellow pill and an outlined pill. On phones the strip wraps to two lines and the bar keeps only the wordmark and a burger that opens a full-width menu.
notes: sticks to the top of the page (position: sticky), so it needs to sit directly in the page container
the phone menu is a native <details>; no JavaScript
the bar is the theme's secondary colour (aubergine in pilot-theme)
name: pilot-header

props.name: announcement
props.type: { text: string; link: { label: string; href: string; }; }
props.description: the pink strip on top: a sentence and an uppercase mono link; leave out to hide the strip

props.name: signIn
props.description: the plain mono link on the right, e.g. "Sign in"

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the phone menu button
